title: Video doorbell
prompt: a video doorbell by a front door with a chime and phone: press the button so the chime rings and the phone shows the picture, trigger motion outside, talk back through the speaker, and switch to night mode; see-through shows the camera, motion sensor, microphone, speaker, chip and Wi-Fi radio
blurb: Ring the chime, see a visitor on the phone, and follow motion alerts and two-way audio through a video doorbell.
